notes: litert-community/LFM3-1.7B-Base-LiteRT: LFM3-1.7B-Base_int8_ekv4096.litertlm, a LiteRT-LM conversion of LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B-Base at revision 7bca5038 (LFM Open License v1.0), the pre-trained base checkpoint of a hybrid decoder (13 short-convolution, 6 global-attention and 5 sliding-window layers), text in, text out. Raw text goes in on the Session path (no chat template; LiteRT-LM puts the start token in front) and the model continues it, rarely ending it, so the caller limits the new tokens. One text or conversation per Engine (a new session on a used Engine continues from the last one's convolution state). Pixel 11 Pro (phone 67170DLKX00C9J) rows: run r1 on 2026-11-08 JST, the 8 questions per backend (one process each). Landed 2026-11-08: litert-community/LFM3-1.7B-Base-LiteRT is public, upload commit 36a0291c7a (2026-11-08T07:51:19+00:00), main 829c1f608e (the card commit, 2026-11-08T08:03:41+00:00) at the read; the tree's LFS oid and size of LFM3-1.7B-Base_int8_ekv4096.litertlm = artifact_sha256 and 1802414928 B (anonymous, read 2026-11-08T18:09:16+09:00).
quantization: every weight int8 per channel (ai-edge-quantizer dynamic_wi8_afp32; on the CPU XNNPACK quantizes the activations to int8 at run time); the file declares no sampler (LiteRT-LM decodes greedily) and no activation type (the GPU runs float16 activations by default); KV cache 4,096 tokens
